title: devx-sdk-scratchpad-tasks
content:
Personal scratchpad for SDK/docs work — quick notes, micro-plans, and things I don’t want to lose. Mostly stream-of-consciousness + small task list.

Context: developer-experience owner for JS + Python SDK docs. Goal this sprint: close top doc gaps for hosted API quickstarts, land 2 sample apps, and triage tutorial fixes flagged by support.

Today (quick log): 2024-06-15
- Morning: synced w/ Marcus (15m) — confirmed embed API changes landed on backend; need examples update.
- Follow-ups: ping infra about CORS headers on staging (ticket ENGINF-993).
- Blocker: sample app #2 fails on auth refresh flow in dedicated env — root cause likely token cache TTL logic (need to repro locally).

Checklist (actionable items)
- [ ] Update JS quickstart to show streaming usage + fallback (est 2h) — priority: high
    - Replace current streaming example with new streaming-client snippet
    - Include note about chunked responses and partial JSON parse gotchas
    - Add curl + Node examples for parity
- [ ] Python SDK docs: clarify sync vs async client behavior (est 3h) — priority: medium
    - Add table mapping: client.fn -> blocking/non-blocking, when to use which
- [ ] Sample app: "chat-with-redis-cache" (make reproducible demo) (est 6h) — priority: high
    - Steps: isolate token refresh failure; write minimal repro; open PR with failing test
- [ ] Tutorial fix: multitenant guide step 4 ambiguous wording (engdoc-412) (est 1h) — priority: low
- [ ] Add migration note for Hosted API quota headers change announced May 2024 (est 30m)
- [ ] Create a short troubleshooting section for 429 vs 503 behavior (est 1h)

Notes / fragments for doc edits
- Streaming example (JS):
  const res = await client.responses.stream({
    model: 'redwood-16k',
    input: 'Translate: English -> FR: Hello world',
    onDelta: chunk => { /* update UI */ }
  });
  // emphasize: handle partial JSON payloads; buffer until valid JSON when using structured output

- Curl fallbacks: include both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 examples; some customers test using curl -v that hits older proxies.

- Quickstart pain points reported by support:
  - Missing example for function calling + tool availability
  - No clear sample for streaming + function-calls combined (edge case)
  - Embeddings quickstart shows older dimension numbers (needs update)

Bugs/triage notes
- token refresh race in dedicated env: observed TTL=0 on certain sequential requests. Local repro steps I want to run:
  1) Start local dedicated-dev with minimal config (docker-compose)
  2) run sample app with high concurrency (wrk or ab)
  3) instrument client cache (console.log on fetchToken)
  4) try sequence: create session -> expire token -> parallel requests -> see 401 loop
  Possibility: missing singleflight locking on refresh path (look for mutex in client code)

Links / references
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk (main repo)
- PR to update streaming example (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789
- Jira/Linear: ENGDOC-412, ENGINF-993
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVX/SDK-Guides (internal)

Todo ordering / sprint slices (for planning)
- Sprint A: streaming + function-calls examples (deliverable: updated quickstart + one sample app)
- Sprint B: caching docs + token refresh troubleshooting guide (deliverable: troubleshooting page + test harness)
- Sprint C: embeddings dimension/nearest-neighbor sample app + perf notes

Thoughts for readability and DX improvements (notes-to-self)
- Keep code examples under 40 lines; link to full sample repo instead of embedding long files
- Add small "expected responses" JSON blobs under each example so readers can sanity-check output
- For streaming, include both raw bytes example and parsed JSON path; some readers prefer one or the other

Random quick reminders
- Ask Sofia to review the API surface section for idiomatic Python patterns (DM)
- Remind product to confirm SLA wording for streaming SLOs (email to pmt)
- Move sample-app READMEs into /examples folder in repo and cross-link from docs

Unresolved questions (to clear before finalizing)
- Do we want to recommend the `responses.stream` pattern as default in quickstart? (prod says: conservative—present streaming as opt-in)
- Should we include a formal migration note for the embedding dimension change or just inline note in embeddings quickstart?

Mini changelog (for PR description)
- updated: JS streaming example + fallback notes
- clarified: Python sync vs async mapping table
- added: troubleshooting section for token refresh in dedicated
- fixed: embeddings dimension numbers

Slack snippets to paste when announcing changes
- Updated JS quickstart and streaming examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 — please review; includes sample app that demonstrates streaming fallback.
- WIP: sample app that reproduces token refresh race in dedicated. DM me if you can repro faster.

End of scratchpad entry. Keep this doc as ephemeral workspace — will split into PR body, confluence draft, and Jira subtasks when I start editing.
